name: labdesk
description: Convenience scripts over server/, client/ and e2e/ (each has its own package.json).

scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix e2e run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix e2e test
